text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
O-Ni-Gi-Ri Rock-Paper-Scissors, 
Rock-Paper――

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: —Tawara!! —Totsu!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! Activating samurai skill! 
—'Deploy to the Field'!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Not gonna let ya! I'll show you the true 
grit of a peasant! —'Peasant Uprising'!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You neutralized it?! Then how about 
this—"Sword Hunt"!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"So that's how it's gonna be...! Then I'll 
use my secret weapon too—'Bamboo Spear'!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! 'Sword Hunt' can't neutralize 
'Bamboo Spear'!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If that's how it's gonna be... it's all 
or nothing! 'Cataclysm'!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Stop it!! The entire field is gonna 
fall into a "State of Famine"!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What even is this game?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I just arrived here myself, so... 
schwierig. It is very difficult to 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey guys. This here is "Onigiri 
Rock-Paper-Scissors"!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Cylinder onigiri represent farmers, convex 
onigiri represent samurai, and triangular 
onigiri represent, well, onigiri.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The rules are: the peasant loses to the 
samurai and the rice ball, and the samurai 
also loses to the rice ball.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
However, there is an exception to the 
battle between peasants and samurai. It is 
when a samurai calls out for "Deployment."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, a samurai might wage 
war— but conversely, they could also end 
up being stopped from fighting.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"That is the peasants' 'Uprising' call. 
The only thing that can stop it is the 
samurai's 'Sword Hunt' call. But, you 
see—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If they bring out a “bamboo spear,” the 
“sword hunt” becomes meaningless. It turns 
into a stalemate.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And during a stalemate, both players are 
permitted to call "Cataclysm."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... If you call 'Cataclysm', the 
field either enters 'Bountiful Harvest' or 
'Famine'...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! In other words, we are in a 
seriously dangerous situation right now! 
...Do you get it now?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Did you get what that means?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If there is one thing I have 
come to understand—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—So, does throwing out a triangular 
onigiri first mean you win?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Knowing the two of them, I doubt they'd 
carry it out if they deemed it "boring," 
but...
